title: RallyAI Stage
description: A rally stage: drivable corridor with elevation, camber, surfaces, pace notes and obstacles. Coordinates are right-handed z-up (x east, y north, z up); see schemas/README.md. Arc length s runs 0..length_m from start to finish and never wraps.

id.description: Stable identifier. Generated stages use gen_<seed>_t<tier>.

name.description: Human-facing stage name, shown in WATCH.

generator.description: Provenance. A stage is reproducible from these fields alone: same version + same seed + same tier must yield a byte-identical file on any machine.

version.description: Generator algorithm version. Bump whenever output changes for a fixed seed.

tier.description: Curriculum difficulty tier. The single scalar that moves length, width, mu, corner severity, elevation aggression and obstacle proximity together.

authored.description: True for hand-authored fixtures and demos, which are exempt from seed reproducibility.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation of this file with content_hash removed. Lets a replay prove which stage it was recorded against.

length_m.description: Total centerline arc length. Must equal the accumulated distance through centerline points.

centerline.description: Ordered corridor samples from start to finish. One object per line so a moved point is a one-line diff.

s.description: Arc length from the start line, metres.

z.description: Road surface height at the centerline.

width.description: FULL drivable width in metres, centred on the centerline. Half-width is width/2 — v1 mixed the two conventions between files, so this one says which it is.

camber.description: Bank angle in radians. Positive banks INTO a left-hand turn (raises the right edge). Negative is off-camber.

surfaces.description: Contiguous surface segments covering 0..length_m with no gaps and no overlaps.

mu.description: Peak friction coefficient. Feel targets: gravel 0.65-0.78, tarmac 0.90-1.05, snow 0.28-0.45.

pace_notes.description: Co-driver calls derived from the geometry. The ONLY look-ahead the agent gets beyond its own senses.

s.description: Arc length of the feature being called.

text.description: Rendered call, e.g. 'left 4 tightens into right 2'.

obstacles.description: Anything solid. s and lateral are REDUNDANT with x/y and are stored anyway so the corridor-intrusion invariant is auditable by reading the file.

z.description: Base height. Defaults to the road surface beneath it.

height.description: Visual height; also whether the car can land on it.

s.description: Arc length of the nearest centerline point.

lateral.description: Signed offset from the centerline at s, positive to the right of travel. |lateral| - radius > width/2 means the obstacle is clear of the drivable corridor.

heading.description: Radians about +z. Should match the centerline tangent at s.

meta.description: Non-load-bearing annotations. Nothing in sim/ may read this.
